newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB appoints technical services chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB appoints technical services chief.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Thursday it appointed Glenn Mescher to the new role of general manager, National Australia Group (Asia Pacific) Services.
Mescher, 49, would be responsible for establishing National Australia Group (Asia Pacific) Services as an information technology services provider for the bank in the Asia-Pacific region.
The new unit would manage the information technology resources of the Australian banking and financial services operations, Bank of New Zealand and National Australia Bank Asia.
NAB said the concept of a regional information technology services unit was successfully pioneered in the United Kingdom and Ireland operations over the past two years.
Mescher was formerly general manager operations of the information technology group of state-owned telecommunications giant Telstra Corp.
